production_rules.final_lettering: ALL CAPS; Chapter 11 Page 4 style; no bold; italics only for emphasis
production_rules.art_png: Artwork only; no non-diegetic text/balloons/tails/captions/folios/page numbers/panel numbers.

production_rules.text_txt: Authoritative exact reader-visible wording by panel.

global_script_rules: LETTERING STANDARD (STRICT): Use the Chapter 11 Page 4 comic lettering style. Final rendered lettering is ALL CAPS, clean rounded comic sans-serif, consistent size throughout the page, no bold, and italics only for deliberate emphasis. All speech bubbles on a page use the same lettering style. Script dialogue remains mixed case here for editorial readability; lettering conversion to ALL CAPS occurs at production/render time.

VISUAL CONTINUITY (STRICT): Chapter 10 begins immediately after Chapter 9 in early morning. Midori retains her canonical black hair and established appearance throughout; do not alter hair length, facial structure, or body type to indicate elapsed time. She turns from 13 to 14 Earth years during the two-mon interval, but this is subtle maturation, not a redesign. She wears her canonical blue floral shrine-maiden clothing until Helena's robe-changing sequence; after the change she wears the same Temple novice robes consistently. The shrine-maiden robes remain stored in Helena's lacquered chest. No injuries are introduced during training unless explicitly scripted. Exterior Zora scenes remain consistent with Spring Mon and the stated time of day; do not invent abrupt weather changes. Props persist until explicitly put away, handed off, consumed, or replaced.

ASSET BINDING REGISTRY (STRICT — CHAPTER 10 PACKAGE): Bind only assets actually present in Assets(20261007-212010).zip. Characters: Midori -> Assets/Midori Character Sheet 13A.png + 13B.png + 13C.png; Seraphine -> Assets/Seraphine character sheet.png; Roselyn -> Assets/Roselyn Character Sheet.png; Lucia -> Assets/Lucia Character Sheet.png + Assets/Lucia model sheet.png + Assets/Lucia Expression Sheet.png; Helena -> Assets/Helena Model Sheet.png; Eliane -> Assets/Eliane Character Sheet.png; Aurelia -> Assets/Aurelia Character Sheet.png; Celeste -> Assets/Celeste Character Sheet.png; Sherin -> Assets/Sherin-Character-Sheet.png; Frenklyn -> Assets/Frenklyn-Character-Sheet.png; Zorna -> Assets/Zorna-character-sheet.png + Assets/Zorna-expression-sheet.png + Assets/Zorna-canonical-character-specification.txt. Costume/world references: shrine-maiden costume -> Assets/Shrine-Maiden-Costume-Production-Sheet.png; Temple clothing language/novice robes -> Assets/Temple-Clothing-Evolution-Sheet.png; Temple of Light architectural language/exterior -> Assets/Temple-of-Light-Evolution-Sheet.png + Assets/Temple-of-Light-Mature-Exterior.png; Seraphine office suite and adjoining room/lavatory geography -> Assets/High-Priestess-SeraphineΓÇÖs-Office-Suite.png; magical lavatory fixture -> Assets/Temple-Lavatory-Fixture-Reference-Sheet.png; Crystal Vault -> Assets/Crystal-Vault-Temple-of-Light.png; WOA/DOTG -> Assets/WOA-canonical-production-specification.txt + Assets/WOA-production-sheet.png + Assets/WOA-production-sheet-plus-map.png + Assets/WOA-observation-field-states-sheet.png. Do not substitute unrelated assets. Do not bind assets merely because a character or object is mentioned in dialogue; bind what is actually visible or directly controls the visible environment/costume. For locations without a standalone sheet, use the Temple of Light architectural-language assets plus within-sequence continuity.

MANGA PRODUCTION RULES (STRICT): Generation canvas is exactly 1024 x 1536 RGB. Final print target is Amazon KDP Premium Color paperback, 6 x 9 inch trim. Do not render an internal trim rectangle. Artwork intended to bleed should extend naturally to the canvas edge; actual bleed, resizing, binding-side crop, DPI handling, CMYK conversion, and final print preparation occur externally.

PAGE PARITY / SAFE AREA (STRICT): Chapter Page 1 is recto; odd chapter pages are recto with left binding edge, even chapter pages are verso with right binding edge. Recto generation-safe area: x=125, y=63, width=836, height=1410. Verso generation-safe area: x=63, y=63, width=836, height=1410. Faces, important hands, essential props/actions, and all required lettering space or readable diegetic text stay inside the safe area. Backgrounds and intentional bleed may extend to the canvas edge. Never render safe-area guides, trim lines, crop marks, registration marks, or bleed guides.

RENDERED-ART CLEANLINESS (STRICT): ART PNG contains artwork only. Do not render chapter/page titles, page numbers, scene numbers, panel numbers, asset names, camera notes, production notes, filenames, safe-area data, dialogue, thoughts, narration, captions, speech balloons, balloon tails, narration boxes, or other non-diegetic reader-visible lettering into the art layer unless a script instruction explicitly identifies the item as diegetic artwork.

DIALOGUE / BALLOON OWNERSHIP (STRICT): (Character: "text") is one speech balloon with exactly one tail pointing only to that named character. A connected -> speech chain belongs to one speaker and has one tail total pointing only to that speaker. Never invent or reassign a speaker, combine different speakers, or add an extra tail. (Character (thinking): "text") is a cloud-shaped thought balloon; a connected thought chain has one thought-dot trail pointing only to that character. Never create a thought balloon unless '(thinking)' is explicitly present. Narration/captions have no speech tail.

SPEAKER / READING ORDER (STRICT): A speaking character should normally be visually identifiable unless the script explicitly requires off-panel speech or another deliberate exception. Preserve unambiguous left-to-right, top-to-bottom reading order. Reserve negative space for lettering so balloons/captions do not cover faces, important gestures, essential props, critical action, or necessary environmental information.

LETTERING WORKFLOW (STRICT): Clip Studio Paint is authoritative for final lettering and page compositing. Generated lettering is provisional registration guidance only. Do not place empty balloons, tails, narration boxes, or caption furniture in the ART PNG. Reference lettering at generation scale is approximately 20 px, adjustable 16-24 px, never below 16 px; approximate balloon/caption padding 14-18 px. Final font, capitalization, kerning, line spacing, balloon geometry, tails, and exact placement are determined in CSP. Preserve the chapter's Chapter-11-Page-4 lettering reference and exact scripted wording/punctuation.

READER-VISIBLE / DIEGETIC TEXT (STRICT): Dialogue, thoughts, narration, captions, editorial/display lettering, and other non-diegetic text belong to the lettering workflow, not the artwork layer. Diegetic writing may appear in art only when explicitly required by the script. Exact diegetic wording must be preserved. Japanese dialogue remains actual Japanese script where explicitly specified; never replace it with faux-Japanese, romanization, decorative pseudo-glyphs, or Zoran script. Zoran writing/translation instructions remain local authoritative exceptions.

THREE-FILE PAGE DELIVERY (STRICT): Every rendered story page requires coordinated files: [page-id]-art.png (complete artwork only); [page-id]-lettering.png (transparent RGBA provisional registration/template overlay); and [page-id]-text.txt (authoritative reader-visible text organized by panel and preserving exact wording, punctuation, speaker, type, and connected-chain relationships). ART and LETTERING PNGs are both exactly 1024 x 1536 with identical origin, crop, orientation, and registration; no scaling or translation between them. The TXT is authoritative for wording/punctuation; the lettering overlay is authoritative only for suggested placement.

CHARACTER / ASSET CANON (STRICT): Canonical character specifications and sheets control identity, face construction, anatomy, proportions, facial features, eye color, hair color/style/length, skin tone, body build, posture, demeanor, costume, and accessories. Canonical production sheets/specifications control environments, props, technology, symbols, and effects. Correct generated conflicts to canon; never creatively redesign recurring characters or locations. A reference labeled 'Inspired by' is non-canonical and may guide only broad compatible atmosphere/composition. Never invent a generic multi-point star/compass or substitute mystical emblem when canon has not defined one.

POPULATION / EXTRAS (STRICT): Anonymous extras must not clone named characters. Vary plausible age appearance, height, weight, build, face, grooming, hairstyle, posture, attractiveness, and other ordinary traits within applicable world/population canon. Avoid fashion-catalog populations. Background characters remain subordinate unless the script explicitly calls attention to them.

STYLE / COLOR (STRICT): Local panel style declarations remain authoritative. Zora/mortal-world panels use the established usual full-color realistic manga treatment. DOTG/WOA/SRA panels use approximately 70% photorealistic / 30% manga with realistic anatomy, dimensional lighting/materials, and moderately manga-influenced facial aesthetics; do not substitute flat cel shading or obvious manga line art for normal DOTG scenes. Work in RGB with CMYK print conversion in mind: preserve shadow detail and avoid critical distinctions that depend on neon or extreme RGB-only saturation.

CONTINUITY (STRICT): Unless explicitly changed, character appearance, costume, accessories, injuries, dirt, carried props, environment state, lighting/time of day, screen direction, entrances/exits, and physical changes carry forward across connected scenes. A cast list does not place every listed character in every panel; show only characters required for the beat. Preserve established eyelines, relative scale, screen direction, and spatial relationships.
